title: OnlyJugs Community
description: A server for the OnlyJugs community. Everyone is welcome to join!
body:
## About
The OnlyJugs Community is a server primarily for our community, but everyone is welcome! The server uses our OnlyJugs Modpack which makes survival a bit more challenging by adding The Long Dark inspired mechanics to Minecraft. We also have a economy system based off of the Steam Community Market and chunk protection so you can keep your belongings safe.

## Gameplay
The modpack is mostly small QoL improvements that keep the game feeling close to vanilla — with two major exceptions: Jugs' Calories adds survival needs inspired by The Long Dark, meaning you'll need to manage food, thirst, and fatigue on top of everything else that comes with survival mode. Open Trade introduces an economy system where you can buy and sell items with other players through a market inspired by the Steam Community Market.

## Features
- QoL mods to make certain areas of the game more engaging to play with
- Survival needs to take care of in order to survive
- A server wide trade system to trade with other players
